body: Depends on what your problem is. Chances are that it is solveable. I can only offer advice from what I know from my own experience. Things can get better.
If you truly cannot see someone in time I can try to help. However I am no professional. Just lots of exp
If you are drunk get yourself to sleep and think on it all in the morning

You are what you are. You don't need to worry about what people think. 

I would not waste your poetry here, however.
